notes.title: Version 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback!

This version brings some more fixes, and one additional thing I thought would improve the overall experience:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that could force the game into slow-motion mode
[*] Fixed the trap door near the end of Level 4 - Downpour, it will no longer trap the player in itslef :D
[*] Level design improvements for levels: Level 3 - Three Tower, Level 5 - Valley of Light and Level 6 - Sunfall Rays. Fixing the exploits so that level logic is not broken :)
[*] NEW FEATURE: I've added some useful hints on the loading screen, reminders of some of the game's features and whatever I'll come up in the future :) There are currently 5 hints in random rotation and the list will expand so take a look!
[/list]

[b]One more important thing![/b]
Achievement "Strrrike!" was removed due to being impossible to achieve :D
Sorry about that. I'll come up with more achievements soon!

notes.title: Version 0.6, Steam Next Fest, Your Feedback
notes.notes:
[b]It's been a long time![/b]

I've been busy working on a feature, that unfortunately I had to scrap :D
I started prototyping a story that would explain what, why and where, but in the end came to a conclusion that it would blow the project scope wa-a-ay out of proportion. 

In any case, all this time is not spent in vain, I researched and learned many new things, I have a foundation of a story that i will definitely use later.
More to that, i was fixing and tweaking many small things in parallel.

The game now is at version 0.6.2, already uploaded the latest changes to Steam.

[b]0.6.1[/b]
🟢 Button glyphs now change according to the control method
🔵 Reworked models throughout levels
🔵 Optimizations done to most resource intensive places, like camera and player behaviour code
🔵 Small tweaks and fixes 

[b]0.6.2[/b]
🟢 Expanded game settings to include requested features:
      - Camera zoom behvaior can now be adjusted by selecting one of two options: auto and fixed.
         Auto - zoomed in/out view will automatically return into it's default state after 5 seconds of 
                    inactivity
         Fixed - zoom value will stay fixed until scene is reloaded
      - Camera movement inversion, both vertical and horizontal axles
      - FOV adjustment slider

      Thanks, Defekto, for suggesting these improvements!
🔵 Fix for several incorrectly lit platforms in Level 1 "The Beginning" 

[b]Steam Next Fest[/b]

Almost a week has passed since Steam Next Fest start, although it's practically nothing in global scale, the results far surpassed my expectations.
Wishlist count now stands at 345 and growing, giving a 2.5x boost to the number MemoryMaze had before the fest.
It's so strange and fulfilling seeing my game listed among all the other participants.

[b]Your feedback[/b]

Please feel free to use Discussions in Steam, or ingame Feedback button to suggest anything you think will do the game any good.
Also, please reply in the comments, would you feel comfortable leaving an email address alongside your feedback, so I can reach out and keep you updated?
I mean as an additional optional field in the Feedback window in the game. Let me know!

notes.title: Version 0.4.7 and an Open Playtest Session
notes.notes:
🟢 Additional and reworked puzzles on levels 3 and 4! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012282/a5178c7a657d8ad377ff66016736c3117dd5d656.gif[/img]
And with that, a new way to interact with the memories: you will encounter places, where manual toggle of Memories mode is disabled. Instead you'll need to look for a new type of platform, actually I don't have a name for that yet, but let's call it "Memories toggler" for now :D

It looks and behaves a lot like a teleport, you roll in, you press the interaction button, and it will transfer you into memories. These kinds of transitions will not cost energy, but as soon as you leave the adjacent area, the "No manual toggle" zone, you will be warped out of memories.

🟢 If you take a screenshot with F3 key, you will now see a small thumbnail next to the Feedback form.

🔵 Greatly increased the speed of screenshot taking and sending. Removed delay between pressing F3 and actually seeing the feedback form appear :D
🔵 Steam Deck related enhancements, any text input will now open Steam UI based text input window, going for that "Steam Deck verified" badge :D
🔵 Fixed some Memory Energy pickup related issues, some of them wouldn't respawn even at zero energy levels.
🔵 Small fixes and enhancements

As always, updated Steam and Itch.io downloads, look for links in the previous posts.
Today I want to try something interesting I recently came across.

There's a web based playtesting platform, Playcocola.com, and I'd love for you to try it out!
Here's a link for MemoryMaze's session:

https://app.playcocola.com/i/d008334a-656c-44ab-817e-8a5ef59ffb12

notes.title: Version 0.4.3 is out!
notes.notes:
Visuals, bug fixes and reworked time trial feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012282/6bc5311d176cd36361727ab194bb4fe17ab255a4.gif[/img]

🟢 Time trial is now a separate game mode! 
Now, in order to start a time trial run, you need to clear the level once, then when you go to a cleared level again, there will be a new Clock pickup (Crash Bandicoot, yea :D).
Each time trial attempt will respawn all the green cubes and reset the timer to zero, so that for each player the conditions will be equal.
The final time trial score will depend on the quantity of cubes collected and, of course, time.

🟢 Visuals: 
— New environment materials, giving each platform a richer look and feel. 
— A mountainy landscape down below on each level where there was an endless void before :D
— I totally forgot something else, lots of changes :D

🔵 All this visuals talk brings another improvement, improved materials are better optimized, 
🔵 Lots of bug fixes here and there
🔵 Took out the trash

Currently working on adding new levels!
Also, slowly working towards adding some kind of a story to the game, expanding the lore and giving everything a meaning :)

Version 0.4.3 is live on Steam as a demo and on itch.io as an alpha, take a look!

https://hmwgames.itch.io/memorymaze

P.S. I had to clear all the scores 😬

notes.title: Test, test... is it on...?
notes.notes:
Hi!

My name is Denis, and i'm making a video game :D

Since it's the first post here, 
MemoryMaze is a puzzle platformer, inspired by the game I used to love as a kid, 2004's Ballance.
I tried to recreate the relaxing, zen-like experience from the inspirer and try to bring something new to the mix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012282/6bbec2c760c3c0583a9fc30e1b687de3ceca0577.png[/img]

The game has been in development for a year now, It's currently on version 0.3.0-alpha and there's a demo version available with the first 5 levels.

I'll be posting regular updates about the dev process, new features and just my thoughts here!
